{{Quote|I have purchased two tickets for the City Tour, but I have important business on Alderaan and I must leave at once. I was hoping that I could sell them to you.|The Chagrian to Panaka|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' (video game)]]</ref>}}
An '''unidentified Chagrian''' had business on both the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He or she was present in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], the planet-wide city of Coruscant, when the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to plead her people's case before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. While the Chagrian had planned to go on a sightseeing trip with [[Coruscant City Tours]], they were forced to travel to the nearby world of Alderaan, where urgent matters required their presence. The Chagrian, who had already bought two tickets for the tour, was able to sell them to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], Chief of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security Force]] for Queen Amidala.
